description: Which genre places which kinds of piece, and the archetype key each carries (P9j.core-asset-kinds, operator ruling U103(1)). A recipe-plan genre's pieces live under the five roots as <root>.<module>.<kind>[.<variant>] (GENRE_PIECE_KINDS, src/archetypes/taxonomy.ts). kinds = genrePieceKindsFor(genre): the kinds of every piece module (platformer, puzzle, strategy) the genre's bundle activates (resolveActiveModules), with each kind's key, allowed variants (a list, "segment" for any legal taxonomy segment, or []) and the fact it is derived from (null: no fact names one, the build plan or the assistant places it), and the art slots; a genre the registry does not know is refused. key = genrePieceKeyFor(genre, kind, variant?), refused in this order: unknown-genre, unknown-kind, kind-not-placed, invalid-variant. pieces = genrePiecesFor(genre, {course?, puzzle?, campaign?}): every piece the definitions name, as WorldIR.entities.genrePieces entries (GenrePieceIR) with the archetype stamped, module by module, kind-table order, then the definition's order, a repeated id once; refused unknown-genre, then by module definition-not-placed (a definition the genre does not place) or missing-definition. collect = collectPlaceableEntities({entities: {genrePieces}}) (kind genrePiece; an unknown module, kind or variant is archetype ""); stamp = stampWorldArchetypes over the same, the entity lists it returns and the stamped list (null when absent).
sources: Kinds: GENRE_PIECE_KINDS (src/archetypes/taxonomy.ts); derivation: src/genre-systems/genre-pieces.ts; the binding walk: src/editor/binding/archetypes.ts (deriveGenrePieceArchetype, collectPlaceableEntities, stampWorldArchetypes).
Which genre activates which module: the genre registry and module activation (conformance/genres/registry.json pins them).

Definitions: Thistlecombe's, generated from conformance/genre-mechanics/thistlecombe.world-slice.json exactly as the first cases of conformance/puzzle/definition.json, conformance/platformer/course.json and conformance/strategy/campaign.json pin them, carried inline with only the members a piece is derived from; the rest written in src/editor/binding/genre-pieces-corpus-cases.ts.
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op is an error, never a skip
